subject: maths
question: Hari travels from City A to City B. If Hari drives his car at 1/4 of his normal speed, then he reaches City B 39 minutes late. Find the time (in minutes) that Hari would take to travel from City A to City B if he drove at his normal speed.
solution:
**Given:**

Delay = 39 min

Speed = 1/4 of normal speed

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance / Speed

Delay = Slow Time – Normal Time

**Calculations:**

Let normal time = x min

⇒ Slow time = 4x

⇒ Delay = 4x – x = 3x

⇒ 3x = 39

⇒ x = 13

**∴ Hari’s normal travel time = 13 minutes**
